ProductName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Hybrid Purple OG
Description:
This World Cup Limited Edition, Purple OG is an hybrid bred from Blue Lobster lineage, combining modern candy-forward genetics with the heavy, grounding effects of classic OG cultivars. The aroma is rich and complex — sweet berry candy and ripe fruit layered over earthy pine, sharp diesel, and deep kush undertones. On the inhale, bright notes of sugary fruit and berry sweetness lead the way, followed by layers of gas, earth, and pine that linger on the finish. The effects begin with a gentle wave of euphoria and mental uplift before settling into a deeply relaxing body buzz that melts away stress and tension. Dense, resin-coated buds loaded with shimmering trichomes make this a standout choice for those who appreciate loud flavor and potent effects. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.
Flavor: Berry candy, sweet fruit, pine, diesel, earthy kush
Effects: Relaxing, euphoric, calming
Dominant Terpenes: Limonene, Linalool, Limonene
MetrcItemName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Hybrid Purple OG

ProductName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Indica Sour Animal Cookies
Description: Sour Animal Cookies is a potent indica bred from Animal Cookies × Sour Diesel, combining loud fuel-heavy terps with creamy cookie funk. The aroma punches out of the jar instantly — sharp diesel, sour candy, earthy dough, and rich gas layered over a sweet herbal finish. On the inhale, bold notes of sour fuel and creamy cookie hit first, followed by earthy spice and a lingering kushy sweetness on the exhale. The effects start with an uplifting cerebral rush before melting into a heavy, relaxing body high that keeps you locked in but still vibing. Dense frosty buds with deep green and purple tones make this one a true NorCal pressure strain. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.Flavor: Sour diesel, creamy cookie, earthy dough, gas, herbal sweetnessEffects: Euphoric, relaxing, upliftingDominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene

ProductName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Hybrid El Chivo
Description:
This World Cup Limited Edition, El Chivo is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from OGKB Blueberry Headband × Grape Gas, delivering a loud combination of sweet fruit, creamy gas, and rich dessert-forward terps. The aroma is bold and complex — ripe berries, grape candy, and creamy pastry layered over pungent fuel and earthy spice. On the inhale, sweet blueberry and grape notes lead the way, followed by rich gas, doughy sweetness, and a smooth, lingering finish. The effects come on with an uplifting sense of euphoria and mental ease before settling into a deeply relaxing body buzz that melts away stress without immediately putting you down. Dense, frosty buds coated in shimmering trichomes make this a standout choice for flavor chasers and connoisseurs alike. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.
Flavor: Grape candy, blueberry, creamy pastry, gas, earthy spice
Effects: Euphoric, relaxing, uplifting
Dominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene

ProductName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Indica Sugar Kush
Description:
This World Cup Limited Edition, Sugar Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid bred from Kandy Kush × Hash Plant, delivering rich dessert-forward terps with classic kush depth. The aroma is sweet and inviting — ripe berries, sugary candy, and creamy cake layered over subtle floral notes and earthy spice. On the inhale, sweet fruit and confectionary flavors take center stage, followed by creamy vanilla, kush, and a smooth earthy finish. The effects come on quickly with an uplifting sense of euphoria before settling into a warm, full-body relaxation that melts away stress and tension. Dense, frosty buds and exceptional resin production make this a standout choice for lovers of sweet, potent flower. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.

Description: Lava Flow is a heavy-hitting indica bred from Lava Cake × Pluto × Do-Si-Dos, a three-way cross that stacks rich dessert terps on top of deep, gassy kush funk. Crack the jar and it erupts with sweet grape, chocolate dough, floral earth, and pungent fuel, all sitting on a minty, peppery base. On the inhale, thick notes of grape cake and creamy dough roll in first, followed by earthy gas and a cool, spicy mint that lingers long after the exhale. The effects ease in with a warm, happy headspace before flowing into a full-body melt that slows everything down and keeps you sunk deep into the couch. Chunky, resin-coated buds with dark purple hues and fiery orange pistils make this one a true NorCal heavyweight. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.Flavor: Grape cake, chocolate dough, earthy gas, floral, cool mintEffects: Relaxing, euphoric, sleepyDominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool

ProductName: Mendo Indoor Flower 3.5g Sativa Mango Haze
Description:
Mango Haze is an energizing sativa bred from Northern Lights #5 × Skunk × Haze, combining juicy tropical terps with old-school hazy spice. The aroma bursts out of the jar with ripe mango, tangy citrus, sweet tropical fruit, and earthy incense over a sharp peppery finish. On the inhale, bold notes of sticky mango and bright citrus hit first, followed by spicy haze and a crisp piney sweetness on the exhale. The effects start with a clear, electric cerebral lift that sparks creativity and conversation, keeping you motivated and moving all day without the crash. Long, frosty, golden-green buds glowing with bright orange pistils make this one a true NorCal daytime classic. Grown by master cultivators in our state-of-the-art indoor facility.
